name: WCB Forest Conservation Program
summary: California state grants for planning, acquisition and restoration projects in the state's forests, such as meadow restoration, post-fire restoration, aspen stand enhancement and hazard fuel-reduction thinning.

eligibility.rule: Project provides at least one WCB Strategic Plan benefit
Planning grant leads to a qualifying future implementation project
Implementation application includes intermediate or advanced design plans
Acquisition is from willing sellers and does not exceed fair market value

status.quote: WCB is now accepting pre-applications through the new WCB Project Portal.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible Applicants: Nonprofit Public Agency Tribal Government

geography.quote: The Program supports planning, acquisition, and restoration projects throughout California's forests

access.quote: WCB is now accepting pre-applications through the new WCB Project Portal.

co_finance_required.quote: Cost share is not required but may be beneficial, in particular to complete a larger project.

effort.quote: Applicants will first submit a Pre-application.
you can only submit a Full Application if WCB invites you to.

eligibility.quote: All projects shall provide one or more of the following benefits, as identified in WCB's Strategic Plan:
Planning grants provide funding for necessary activities that will lead to a specific future on-the-ground implementation project(s) that is likely to qualify for future implementation funding.
Implementation applications must include intermediate or advanced design plans (e.g., design plans at ~65% level of development or higher).
Acquisitions, in the form of conservation easement, water rights, and fee purchases, must be from willing sellers and at a price that does not exceed the fair market value.

after_award.quote: All grantees doing restoration, development, scientific studies, and planning will be required to provide a final report.
